CREATE TABLE change_request_versions (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	change_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	previous_version_id UUID, 
	previous_revision INTEGER, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	intent_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	request_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	request_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	sources JSONB NOT NULL, 
	required_source_read_set JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_basis JSONB NOT NULL, 
	authority_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, change_id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, change_id, id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, change_id, id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, owner_id, operation, intent_digest), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_id) REFERENCES principals (tenant_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, change_id, previous_version_id, previous_revision) REFERENCES change_request_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, change_id, id, revision), 
	CHECK (visibility IN ('private','product') AND status IN ('draft','analysis')), 
	CHECK (operation IN ('change.request.create','change.impact.compute')), 
	CHECK ((revision = 1 AND previous_version_id IS NULL AND previous_revision IS NULL) OR (revision > 1 AND previous_version_id IS NOT NULL AND previous_revision IS NOT NULL AND previous_version_id <> id AND revision = previous_revision + 1)), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(request_snapshot->>'status' = status, false)), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(request_snapshot->'orders' = '[]'::jsonb, false)), 
	CHECK (COALESCE((request_snapshot->>'revision')::integer = revision, false)), 
	CHECK (jsonb_array_length(required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
)

CREATE TABLE quality_issue_versions (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	previous_issue_version_id UUID, 
	previous_revision INTEGER, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	writer_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	purpose TEXT NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL, 
	operation VARCHAR(80) NOT NULL, 
	issue_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	snapshot_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	input_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	authority_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	policy_snapshot JSONB, 
	sources JSONB NOT NULL, 
	required_source_read_set JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_basis JSONB NOT NULL, 
	intent_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, previous_issue_version_id, previous_revision) REFERENCES quality_issue_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_id) REFERENCES principals (tenant_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, writer_id) REFERENCES principals (tenant_id, id), 
	CHECK (revision>0 AND visibility IN ('private','product')), 
	CHECK (status IN ('open','triaged','actioning')), 
	CHECK (operation IN ('quality.issue.create','quality.issue.merge','quality.issue.triage','quality.issue.containment.record','quality.capa.draft')), 
	CHECK (jsonb_typeof(required_source_read_set)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20), 
	CHECK ((revision=1 AND previous_issue_version_id IS NULL AND previous_revision IS NULL) OR (previous_issue_version_id IS NOT NULL AND previous_revision IS NOT NULL AND previous_issue_version_id<>id AND revision=previous_revision+1)), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(issue_snapshot->>'id'=issue_id::text AND (issue_snapshot->>'revision')::integer=revision AND issue_snapshot->>'status'=status,false)), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(issue_snapshot->'scope'->>'tenant_id'=tenant_id::text AND issue_snapshot->'scope'->>'product_id'=product_id::text AND issue_snapshot->'scope'->>'project_id'=project_id::text,false))
)

CREATE TABLE quality_policy_facts (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	purpose TEXT NOT NULL, 
	series_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	previous_id UUID, 
	previous_revision INTEGER, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	risk VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	independent_verification BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	valid_from TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	valid_until TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	issuer_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	issuer_version VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	issuer_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	nature VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	data JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sources JSONB NOT NULL, 
	required_source_read_set JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_basis JSONB NOT NULL, 
	fact_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id) REFERENCES projects (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, previous_id, previous_revision) REFERENCES quality_policy_facts (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_id) REFERENCES principals (tenant_id, id), 
	CHECK (nature='synthetic' AND status IN ('active','withdrawn') AND risk IN ('low','medium','high','critical')), 
	CHECK (revision>0 AND issuer_epoch>0 AND valid_until>valid_from AND visibility IN ('private','product')), 
	CHECK ((revision=1 AND previous_id IS NULL AND previous_revision IS NULL AND series_id=id) OR (previous_id IS NOT NULL AND previous_revision IS NOT NULL AND previous_id<>id AND revision=previous_revision+1)), 
	CHECK (jsonb_typeof(required_source_read_set)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
)

CREATE TABLE change_graph_captures (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	change_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	change_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	change_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	owner_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	visibility VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL, 
	capture_key VARCHAR(160) NOT NULL, 
	input_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	graph_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	graph_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	sources JSONB NOT NULL, 
	required_source_read_set JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_basis JSONB NOT NULL, 
	authority_snapshot JSONB NOT NULL, 
	expires_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	reason TEXT NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, id, revision), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, owner_id, capture_key), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, change_id, change_version_id, change_revision) REFERENCES change_request_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, change_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, owner_id) REFERENCES principals (tenant_id, id), 
	CHECK (revision = 1 AND status = 'prepared' AND change_revision > 0), 
	CHECK (visibility IN ('private','product')), 
	CHECK (expires_at > created_at AND expires_at <= created_at + interval '10 minutes'), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(graph_snapshot->>'nature' IN ('real','synthetic'), false)), 
	CHECK (jsonb_array_length(required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
)

CREATE TABLE change_request_currents (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	change_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, change_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, change_id, version_id, revision) REFERENCES change_request_versions (tenant_id, product_id, change_id, id, revision), 
	CHECK (revision > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE quality_current_issues (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, issue_version_id, issue_revision) REFERENCES quality_issue_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, id, revision), 
	CHECK (issue_revision>0 AND epoch>0)
)

CREATE TABLE quality_current_policies (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	purpose TEXT NOT NULL, 
	series_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	fact_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	fact_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	issuer_key VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, 
	external_id VARCHAR(200) NOT NULL, 
	epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, issuer_key, external_id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, fact_id, fact_revision) REFERENCES quality_policy_facts (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, purpose, series_id, id, revision), 
	CHECK (epoch>0 AND fact_revision>0)
)

CREATE TABLE quality_failure_maps (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	failure_identity VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	issue_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	failure JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, failure_identity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id) REFERENCES quality_current_issues (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id) DEFERRABLE INITIALLY DEFERRED, 
	CHECK (epoch>0 AND length(failure_identity)=64), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(failure->>'identity'=failure_identity AND failure->'build'->>'product_id'=product_id::text AND failure->'build'->>'project_id'=project_id::text,false))
)

CREATE TABLE quality_event_failure_links (
	product_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	project_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	issue_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	event_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	failure_identity VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	build_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	request_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	run_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	run_version_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	run_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	measurement_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	measurement_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	projection_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	projection_revision INTEGER NOT NULL, 
	basis_sha256 VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	failure JSONB NOT NULL, 
	sources JSONB NOT NULL, 
	required_source_read_set JSONB NOT NULL, 
	source_basis JSONB NOT NULL, 
	id UUID NOT NULL, 
	tenant_id UUID NOT NULL, 
	created_at TIMESTAMP WITH TIME ZONE NOT NULL, 
	PRIMARY KEY (id), 
	UNIQUE (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, event_id, failure_identity), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, issue_version_id, issue_revision) REFERENCES quality_issue_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, issue_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, build_id, run_id) REFERENCES verification_run_identities (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, build_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, run_version_id, run_revision) REFERENCES verification_run_versions (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, measurement_id, measurement_revision) REFERENCES test_measurements (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, projection_id, projection_revision) REFERENCES test_result_projections (tenant_id, product_id, project_id, request_id, run_id, id, revision), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, event_id) REFERENCES outbox_events (tenant_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, measurement_id) REFERENCES test_measurements (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	FOREIGN KEY(tenant_id, product_id, projection_id) REFERENCES test_result_projections (tenant_id, product_id, id), 
	CHECK (run_revision>2 AND issue_revision>0 AND projection_revision>0), 
	CHECK (measurement_revision=1), 
	CHECK (COALESCE(failure->>'identity'=failure_identity AND failure->'run'->>'id'=run_id::text AND (failure->'run'->>'revision')::integer=run_revision AND failure->>'measurement_id'=measurement_id::text AND failure->'build'->>'id'=build_id::text AND failure->'build'->>'product_id'=product_id::text AND failure->'build'->>'project_id'=project_id::text,false)), 
	CHECK (jsonb_typeof(required_source_read_set)='array' AND jsonb_array_length(required_source_read_set) BETWEEN 1 AND 20)
)
